newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it kills 37 Kurdish rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it kills 37 Kurdish rebels.

text.p: Security forces have killed 37 Kurdish guerrillas in a series of clashes this week in eastern Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office said on Thursday.
Troops killed 14 rebels in Hakkari province, near the Iraqi border, and three others in Sirnak province, the office said in a statement.
Earlier, it said 20 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels had been killed in fighting across a number of eastern provinces.
There was no indication of any military casualties, or when the fighting took place.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in a 12-year-old conflict between troops and the rebels, fighting for autonomy or independence from Ankara.
Anatolian news agency said the guerrillas killed a pro-state militiaman near the Iranian border on Thursday.
